release_notes: **Repairs → Add stock part** could crash with `NameError: QDoubleSpinBox` when opening the part picker — the widget was used without being imported. Now imported alongside the other widgets.; **Barcode generation** could crash a second time while reporting a failure (`_log` was never defined in the service); a logger is now created so the real error is logged instead.; **Reports page** shadowed the global `THEME` with a local import; **Device sold-history dialog** referenced `QWidget` before importing it. Both cleaned up; `ruff` now reports zero undefined-name / redefinition findings across the app.
